title: Graphify Enrichment Provider State
description: Tracks installation and graph-build state for the optional Graphify enrichment provider. Written by scripts/install-graphify.ps1 and scripts/graphify_provider.py.

status.description: DISABLED=provider not configured; MISSING=installed but graph not built; READY=graph current; STALE=source files newer than graph; FAILED=last build error

version_constraint.description: Version constraint used during install, e.g. '>=0.9.28'

install_path.description: Resolved path to the graphify executable

graph_path.description: Path to graph.json relative to project root

node_count.description: Number of nodes in the last successful graph build

link_count.description: Number of links/edges in the last successful graph build

last_built.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last successful graph build

build_duration_s.description: Duration of last graph build in seconds

source_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of indexed source files at last build

scope_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of .graphifyignore content at last build. Changes trigger automatic graphify-out/ wipe before rebuild to prevent stale broad graph contamination.

local_only.description: True if external API keys were suppressed during the last build

error.description: Error message from last failed build or install
